title: Fekete gyémántok

At the start of the narrative, the reader is introduced to a world from the distant past, where the earth is an untamed wilderness and prehistoric creatures roam freely. As the tale progresses, it transitions from the grand features of nature and the life that once dominated it to a focus on a solitary man who navigates the dark, perilous depths of a coal mine, battling both the physical dangers of mining as well as profound existential concerns about life and death in this haunting, subterranean realm.
